title: Disaster Response Robot VLM Scene Report V1
description: The complete and only JSON object a VLM may return for a V1 scene description. The response is descriptive evidence, never a command, authorization, lifecycle transition, or safety override.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Any value other than 1 is rejected without coercion.

best_direction.description: Observed apparent open direction for logging and research analysis only. It must not select a turn or otherwise increase motion authority in the controlled V1 baseline.

confidence.description: Model self-assessed confidence only. It cannot relax any sensor, safety, or lifecycle constraint.

notes.description: Optional human-readable logging context. It is never parsed or used in decisions, safety transitions, reset authorization, or motor control.

x-versioning.compatibility: Reject unknown fields and all schema_version values other than 1. Additions or changed meanings require a new major schema file and prompt version.

x-vlm-bounded-role.title: VLM bounded role
x-vlm-bounded-role.allowed: Describe visible scene evidence using only this object.
x-vlm-bounded-role.enforcement: The validator accepts only this schema. The deterministic decision engine and safety gate independently apply configuration, sensor evidence, and lifecycle rules.
